routes.description: Escrow an encrypted recovery blob: stored opaquely — we cannot decrypt it — for operator review, signed receipt proving its hash; quorum_rules govern release. POST the tool inputs as JSON to paid_url with an x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. See https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/x402

Your conditions, one fetch: status, substring, JSON value — signed pass/fail receipt. Default status 200. Public proof: check_url_sealed. Watch: check_url_changes. POST the tool inputs as JSON to paid_url with an x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. See https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/x402

Proof anyone can verify: one fetch, transcript sealed in a signed receipt — HTTP 200 at that moment, fixed at 200. Your own conditions instead: check_url_custom. POST the tool inputs as JSON to paid_url with an x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. See https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/x402

GPU price, sealed proof: snapshot, cheapest ask/class, signed receipt. type defaults ondemand; omit gpu = all classes. Raw: compute_spot_prices. POST the tool inputs as JSON to paid_url with an x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. See https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/x402

Buy/don't-buy verdict on an x402 endpoint: probed unpaid, signed PROCEED, VERIFY_FIRST, or DO_NOT_PAY. Terms: trust_preflight. Action gate: trust_assurance. POST the tool inputs as JSON to paid_url with an x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. See https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/x402

Before paying: who is paid, what's delivered, what changed — signed verdict against your policies. Free quote: dry_run=true. Endpoint verdict: trust_report. POST the tool inputs as JSON to paid_url with an x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. See https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/x402

GPU market memory: cheapest and median asks per class, in a signed receipt. limit defaults to 50. Live: compute_spot_prices. Moves: compute_alerts. POST the tool inputs as JSON to paid_url with an x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. See https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/x402

GPU price moves that matter: significant spot moves, in a signed receipt. limit defaults to 25. Live snapshot: compute_spot_prices. Past: compute_history. POST the tool inputs as JSON to paid_url with an x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. See https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/x402

The research paper: $222.00; $444.00 with the provenance pack — paper plus its proof. bundle defaults to paper; prior receipt: $222.00 upgrade. Licensed to your wallet. POST the tool inputs as JSON to paid_url with an x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. See https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/x402

Action gate: endpoint, action, amount, permissions probed unpaid — ALLOW, RESTRICT, ASK_HUMAN, or QUARANTINE. Verdict: trust_report. Terms: trust_preflight. POST the tool inputs as JSON to paid_url with an x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. See https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/x402

Issue an Agent ID: attestation binding a pubkey to a verified principal — unverifiable are refused. validity_days defaults to standard. Verify: agentid_verify. POST the tool inputs as JSON to paid_url with an x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. See https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/x402

Agent ID state — valid, revoked, expired, or unknown — chain + envelope included. Unknown IDs: unknown, never error. Issue: agentid_issue; extend: agentid_renew. POST the tool inputs as JSON to paid_url with an x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. See https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/x402

Retire an Agent ID instantly, with no successor: sign as the revocation_signature field specifies — who signs, and how. Fresh ID, same chain: agentid_renew. POST the tool inputs as JSON to paid_url with an x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. See https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/x402

Renew an Agent ID: fresh ID, same chain; the old retires. Sign like a revocation. validity_days defaults to standard. Retire outright: agentid_revoke. POST the tool inputs as JSON to paid_url with an x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. See https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/x402

$25.00 correction pass on your draft: formatting, links verified live, terms confirmed, leaks scanned — corrected copy + signed report. register sets the voice. POST the tool inputs as JSON to paid_url with an x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. See https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/x402

Support the Embassy. Open-amount USDC gift, $0.01–$222. The signed quote binds your exact amount; receipt: patronage, never for work. POST the tool inputs as JSON to paid_url with an x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. See https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/x402

Prove a document existed: send its SHA256 hash — we never see it — for a signed, hash-chained attestation. document_name is an optional label. Live URLs: check_url_custom. POST the tool inputs as JSON to paid_url with an x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. See https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/x402

All checks, one call: liveness, content, TLS fingerprint, trust verdict, doc timestamp — one signed receipt. document_hash optional. One check: the tool alone. POST the tool inputs as JSON to paid_url with an x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. See https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/x402

'Tell me when it changes': a standing URL check — receipt and charge only on change. check_interval_hours defaults to 24. One-time check: check_url_custom. POST the tool inputs as JSON to paid_url with an x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. See https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/x402

Notarize work done anywhere: submit evidence; we verify it and mint a signed receipt. evidence_urls + evidence_hash optional. Document's existence: attest_document. POST the tool inputs as JSON to paid_url with an x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. See https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/x402

Shop an idea: delayed scan — a ticker, two compared, or a theme — expressions fitting your budget, freshness-labeled, signed receipt. budget_usd omitted: uncapped. Ideas only — no orders placed. POST to paid_url with an x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. See https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/x402

Farcaster from zero: first casts, frame spec, launch checklist in one fill-in template with a signed receipt. On Nostr instead: nostr_kit. agent_wallet optional, on the receipt. POST to paid_url with an x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. See https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/x402

Nostr from zero: first notes, profile, relays, launch checklist in one fill-in template with a signed receipt. On Farcaster instead: farcaster_kit. agent_wallet optional, on the receipt. POST to paid_url with an x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. See https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/x402

Skip the sweep: the ranked directory of ranking surfaces — methods, integrity, freshness, our standing — in a signed receipt. Omit surface = full directory. POST the tool inputs as JSON to paid_url with an x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. See https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/x402

Compute market snapshot — observed spot prices: cheapest rentable ask per GPU class in USD/hour. $0.25 per query via x402 USDC on Base, Arbitrum One, or Algorand. Asks are ephemeral — re-observe before any decision. Paid output (shape only, no values): {market, generated_at, classes: [{gpu_class, cheapest_rentable, median_price_per_gpu_hour_usd}], caveats}. One payment buys one fresh observation; values are yours only after the payment settles.
